artifacts.summary: 9-phase S4 tableau plan: 4-rule, LoopChecking.lean equality-blocking machinery, ReflTransGen countermodel extraction, S4 soundness, truth-lemma bridge (Phases 1-7 green/landable), then the high-risk 2^|Sf| termination bound (Phase 8) and 510-gated decidability (Phase 9).

memory_candidates.content: In the CSLib modal tableau tree (Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/), termination machinery splits cleanly along a rule-dependence axis that determines what a new frame system can reuse. Rule-INDEPENDENT and directly reusable: modalWork/modalExpMeasure (FmpMeasure.lean:192/197) take the finite universe U as an explicit parameter and know nothing about worlds, rules, or acc; modalSubfmls/modalDepth/modalComplexity are pure syntax. Reusable only as a TEMPLATE: modalUniverse (:149) is built on top of modalWorldBound, so swapping the world bound regenerates it. NOT reusable: modalWorldBound (:144) is (2*complexity+1)^(complexity+1), a branching^depth TREE bound, and with it geomCap/modalPotential/modalPotentialTerm and ModalPotentialInv's rankBound/rankEdge fields (:2342-2344). Those two rank fields encode 'modal depth strictly decreases along every edge' and are falsified by any transitive or self-propagating rule (S4's 4-rule places T(box phi) — unchanged depth — at a successor; a transitively closed acc has edges w->w'' with rank w''+2 = rank w). Consequence: a frame system whose rules propagate a formula at unchanged modal depth cannot instantiate RuleApplicationSpec (GenericDriver.lean:126; fields outputsSubsetUniverse and rankStep are unsatisfiable) and must supply a pigeonhole-on-subsets bound instead. The correct extension pattern is a SIBLING invariant structure reusing ModalPotentialInv's six rule-independent fields (bClosure/eNodup/eClosure/accFresh/accKnown/outDegEq) — mirroring how ModalLoopInv (CompletenessLoop.lean:57) holds ModalPotentialInv as a field — never adding a field to ModalPotentialInv itself, which would force every K consumer to discharge it.
